sentences.en: Mum and Dad were spring-cleaning.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸是大扫除。

sentences.en: Mum looked in a drawer.
sentences.zh: 妈妈看在……里一个抽屉。

sentences.en: Dad threw things out.
sentences.zh: 爸爸扔东西出。

sentences.en: The children looked at the junk.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们看在这垃圾。

sentences.en: JIGSAW PuzzLE
sentences.zh: 拼图谜

sentences.en: They played with the old toys.
sentences.zh: 他们玩和……一起这旧的玩具。

sentences.en: Mum put the old toys in the car.
sentences.zh: 妈妈放这旧的玩具在……里这汽车。

sentences.en: The children were sad.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是伤心的。

sentences.en: They all went to the jumble sale.
sentences.zh: 他们全部去到这胡乱堆放出售。

sentences.en: The children wanted to buy something.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们想要到买某物。

sentences.en: "What a lot of junk!" said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 什么一个许多的垃圾！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: They counted their money.
sentences.zh: 他们数数他们的钱。

sentences.en: It was time to go home.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到去家。

sentences.en: "What's in the bags?" said Mum.
sentences.zh: 是什么在……里这包？ 说妈妈。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 哦不！

sentences.en: This helps children to notice how words are spelt.
sentences.zh: 这个帮助孩子们到布告如何单词是 spelt。

sentences.en: • Open the book, e.
sentences.zh: • 打开这书， 呃。

sentences.en: I can see 'we' inside were" • Then the child looks for a word inside a word.
sentences.zh: 我能看见 '我们' 里面是 • 然后这孩子看为了一个单词里面一个单词。

sentences.en: If they find this difficult, suggest a word that appears often in words, such as 'in' ('spring', 'cleaning', 'things', etc.
sentences.zh: 如果他们找到这个困难的， 建议一个单词那个出现经常在……里单词， 这样的像 '在……里' ('春天'， '打扫'， '东西'， etc。

sentences.en: • Have two or three turns each.
sentences.zh: • 有二或者三转动每个。

sentences.en: You can use these ideas straight away, or on another day.
sentences.zh: 你能使用这些主意直的离开， 或者在……上另一个一天。

sentences.en: • Find words that end in 'ed'.
sentences.zh: • 找到单词那个末尾在……里 '勃起功能障碍'。

sentences.en: Cover the 'ed' and read the remaining word.
sentences.zh: 遮盖这 '勃起功能障碍' 和读这剩余的单词。

sentences.en: I spy', e.
sentences.zh: 我间谍'， 呃。

sentences.en: I spy with my little eye, something beginning with 'b'."
sentences.zh: 我间谍和……一起我的小的眼睛， 某物开始和……一起 '第二'。

sentences.en: ('ball', 'boxes', 'bear' 'brick", 'boot', 'bolt')
